# Mario Kart 7 (USA, version 1.2): achievements from the save in RAM. Generated by
# tools/mk7_defs.py; don't edit by hand.

# Version 1.2 only: a read-only word that only 1.2 has. Any other version (1.0, a cartridge never
# updated) gets "achievements off: needs version 1.2" instead (needs a tracker that reads "@version").
@version 1.2 0x0064E4FC 4 0xD899E1C9

# The Japanese release's own title is in Japanese, which the banner's font can't show.
@title MARIO KART 7

# CTGP-7 runs Mario Kart 7 with its own save: its progress isn't the game's.
@block-plugin CTGP-7
